message: This has a lot of high-throughput event triggers, make it a scheduled task for 12am every day.
text: Notes Improver is already scheduled for 00:00 each day, and I didn't change it. Scheduling reads its three event types once per run instead of waking on each event, so the high-throughput triggers no longer wake it. It's still unconfirmed, and I still need your time zone to set the run time.

steps: 1. At its daily run, read notes_files and the count of notes files added since the last run.
2. Compare with the previous day's count and the proposal it made last time.
3. If a change is likely to raise the daily count, propose it to the owner first; do not hand work on.
4. Record the day's count and the proposal, whatever they were.
